content: {"summary":"On 3 Aug 2025 a credential‑stuffing attack drove login attempts from ~15 req/s to ~150 req/s. Auth‑service pods, which return 503 once 64 concurrent logins are in flight, hit their CPU limit (2 cores) and began throttling, causing the edge to see 503 responses. Raising each pod’s CPU limit to 4 cores stopped the 503s even though the attack continued, confirming the overload as the root cause.","likely_cause":"Credential‑stuffing overload causing auth‑service pods to exceed concurrency and CPU limits, resulting in 503 responses at the edge","confidence":"high","claims":[{"text":"Login attempts spiked to ~150 per second, about ten times normal","evidence_ids":["INC-0067#0"],"quote":"attempts had gone from the usual 15 or so a second to about 150 a second"},{"text":"The spike matched a credential‑stuffing pattern with many password failures from many IPs","evidence_ids":["INC-0067#0"],"quote":"about 97% of them were failing on the password. They came from a wide spread of addresses"},{"text":"Auth‑service pods cap concurrent logins at 64 and return 503 when exceeded","evidence_ids":["INC-0067#0"],"quote":"once 64 logins are in flight it answers `503`"},{"text":"Both auth pods were at their CPU limit (2 cores) during the surge","evidence_ids":["INC-0067#1"],"quote":"both pods were sitting exactly at their CPU limit"},{"text":"Raising the CPU limit to 4 cores per pod stopped the 503s while attempts continued","evidence_ids":["INC-0067#1"],"quote":"`503`s stopped at 10:34, while the attempts were still arriving at the same rate"},{"text":"There is no rate limit on the login route at the edge, so the edge passed requests straight through","evidence_ids":["INC-0067#1"],"quote":"There is no rate limit on the login route at the edge"}],"next_checks":["Check current CPU limits and usage of auth‑service pods","Add edge rate‑limit for /v1/auth/login per client and globally","Create alert on high share of failed logins","Review concurrency cap (64) and consider increasing or queueing","Monitor bcrypt processing latency under load"]}
